item.title: Software Engineer — AI agents в Wildix, віддалено
item.description:
Hello! ✨

We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect. Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

About Us...

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. With steady growth and a strong foundation, we offer real opportunities to advance your career as we scale, making an impact in a global team that’s shaping the future of work.

At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

About The Role

We’re building the AI layer of business communication — voice agents, chat agents and AI assistants that work in real customer conversations and real phone calls across 135+ countries.

You’ll join our AI Agents stream, an 8-person engineering team owning the product end to end. You’ll build the agents themselves as well as the platform behind them: skills, workflows, tools, connectors, orchestration, observability and the infrastructure that makes AI reliable, fast and measurable in production.

This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who wants to build real AI products, not just integrate AI APIs.



What You Will Do

  • Build and ship AI agent features end to end — from Node.js/TypeScript services on AWS to the interfaces used to configure, test and observe agents.
  • Extend the AI agent platform — building skills, workflows, sandboxes, tools, connectors, tracing, audit and orchestration capabilities.
  • Integrate and orchestrate AI providers — LLM, STT and TTS — using prompt and context engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, streaming and robust failure handling.
  • Make AI quality measurable and production-ready — build evaluations, tracing and monitoring while engineering for latency, reliability, cost, privacy and security.
  • Drive product discovery and ownership — challenge scope, propose solutions, bring your own ideas and stay involved after release by using quality and adoption signals to iterate.
  • Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, architecture decisions, knowledge sharing and collaboration across the AI Agents stream.



What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js backend skills and confidence working across the frontend with React or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered features used by real users in production. You should be able to explain what you built, how it worked and the engineering decisions behind it.
  • Practical experience with AI application patterns including prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG, streaming and handling non-deterministic behaviour in production.
  • Experience making AI systems measurable and observable through evaluations, tracing, monitoring and regression detection.
  • Strong production AWS experience with serverless and/or containerized environments. Our stack includes Lambda/SAM, ECS, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS and OpenSearch.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across REST/API design, WebSockets, SQL and NoSQL data modelling, caching, testing, CI/CD and production debugging.
  • A strong ownership and product mindset — you take initiative, challenge assumptions, work comfortably with ambiguity and turn ideas into shipped features rather than waiting for detailed specifications.
  • English B2 or above.

Bonus Points If

  • You’ve built agentic systems involving multi-step orchestration, tool selection, state management, guardrails or recovery from failures.
  • You’ve worked in security- or privacy-sensitive environments, including GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • You have public evidence of building for the sake of building — open-source contributions, side projects, technical writing, talks or similar.
  • You have experience with real-time audio and communication technologies, such as WebRTC, streaming STT/TTS or low-latency voice pipelines.

Why You’ll Love It Here

👫 Work with a Supportive, High-Performing Team — We believe in trust, autonomy, and working with bright, passionate individuals who drive real impact.

🌍 A Truly International Workplace — Our diverse and inclusive team ensures you’ll always feel connected and supported, no matter where you are.

🚀 Shape the Future of Global Communication — Be part of a team transforming how businesses operate in an era of remote work and AI-powered collaboration.

💼 Join a Profitable & Stable Company — We’re not a startup experiment, we’re a two decade old success story with sustained profitability, meaning we can back your boldest ideas.

What we offer

🏖️ Flexible Time Off — Take the breaks you need to relax, recharge, and come back inspired.

💻 Top-Tier Tech — Love Mac? So do we! We equip our team with the best tools for success.

🚀 Career Growth & Development — Access to programs and events to keep you at the top of your game.

💰 Compensation — The total compensation for this role is between EUR 48,000 and EUR 60,000 per year. The final offer will fall within this range, and reflects the candidate’s skills, experience, and work location.

🌱 Well-being Support — We offer access to psychology sessions to support your mental and emotional health

Happy with them? We offer even more! Our Benefits are country-specific, you can ask your recruiter for more information

Interview Process

🤝 Step 1: Initial Screening — 30 mins| A chat with our Talent Team to understand your background, experience, and motivations.

🛠️ Step 2: Technical Interview — 60 mins| A technical deep dive with your potential Manager and Principal Engineer to assess your skills and fit for the role.

🎯 Step 3: Final Interview — 30 mins| A conversation with leadership to ensure alignment with our values and mission.

We Are Wildix

Wildix is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, age, religion, or any other characteristic. Everyone is encouraged to apply and is welcome to join our Blue Ecosystem.

Ready to join us? Apply Now!

item.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer в NDA Recruitment, $3500–5000, Київ
item.description:
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our team and help build scalable web applications from the ground up. This role combines backend development with TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS), frontend development with React, application architecture, and API design.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain backend services using TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.
  • Build and maintain web applications using React.
  • Design application architecture and technical solutions from scratch.
  • Design, develop, and maintain REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Ensure application security, performance, and scalability.
  • Collaborate closely with business analysts, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and other team members.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with TypeScript and JavaScript, primarily in the Node.js ecosystem.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and NestJS.
  • Commercial experience with React and SPA development.
  • Solid experience working with relational databases.
  • Understanding of asynchronous data processing, message queues, and background jobs.
  • Knowledge of software design patterns and modular or microservice architecture.
  • Basic DevOps skills and understanding of CI/CD, containerization, and application deployment.
  • Ability to design scalable and maintainable applications from the ground up.
  • English proficiency sufficient to read and understand technical documentation.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with non-relational databases.
  • Experience working with AI tools.
